title: Identify a second table-driven European compact root
changes: Record the guarded 16-row table and compact root 0x6c95d4 as a candidate for decoded extraction and runtime consumption.
validation: Wine source disassembly and opcode checks authenticate selector provenance, helper preservation and constructor; three selectors cover 412 bank bytes and 160 nonoverlapping table bytes.
limitations: Source analysis only; extraction, runtime use, ordinary reachability, all producers, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. Thirty-two unread table bytes remain raw. No performance or space measurements.
